# Waskill

> Waskill is a free tool that helps beginner Claude users find the right Claude Agent Skill (a SKILL.md file) for the prompt they are about to send. Paste a prompt, get the top 5 matching skills from popular open-source GitHub repositories (100+ stars), with a link to each SKILL.md and a one-click "copy prompt with skill" button.

Site: https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/
Not affiliated with Anthropic. Runs entirely in the browser; prompts are not sent to any server.

## What are Claude skills?

Claude Agent Skills are folders containing a SKILL.md file (instructions, plus optional scripts and resources) that teach Claude how to do a specific task well, such as making slide decks, filling PDF forms, writing tests, or doing SEO research. Claude loads a skill when it is relevant to the task.

## How to use Waskill

1. Open https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/ and paste the prompt you plan to send to Claude.
2. Click "Suggest skills" to see the 5 best-matching skills, each with category, source repo and star count.
3. Click "View SKILL.md" to read or install the skill (e.g. add it to Claude.ai, Claude Code `~/.claude/skills/`, or the API), or click "Copy prompt with skill" to copy your prompt rewritten to use that skill.
4. Deep link: https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/?q=make%20a%20pitch%20deck runs a search directly.

## Pages

- [Home / search](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/)
- [Skill data (JSON)](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills.json): name, description, repo, stars, url, category for every indexed skill
- [Full index for LLMs](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/llms-full.txt)
- Category pages: [security](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/security.html), [integrations](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/integrations.html), [marketing](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/marketing.html), [data](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/data.html), [documents](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/documents.html), [design](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/design.html), [coding](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/coding.html), [productivity](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/productivity.html), [writing](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/writing.html), [business](https://namt0111.github.io/waskill/skills/business.html)
